findings.summary: AHU-014 is not ready for acceptance. COM-01 (tagged AHU-14) is confirmed as this asset, but its final approval is not signed, which is a critical exception. The warranty serial CX500-818 conflicts with CX500-881 in the register and commissioning certificate, and no PPM plan is configured.
findings.escalation_reason: Evidence conflicts on the serial number and no source settles it (Escalation 2.3; Matching 4.2). The FM handover manager must decide whether to send the clarification request and wait for manufacturer confirmation. The status is stricter than the rule-based Conflicting information because the commissioning approval is unsigned.
findings.clarification_subject: AHU-014: signed commissioning approval, warranty serial and tag correction
findings.clarification_body: Please arrange the following for AHU-014 (Level 3 plant room): 1) Provide the signed final approval for commissioning certificate COM-01 (currently Not signed). 2) Have Climax Air Systems confirm the correct serial number: warranty WAR-01 states CX500-818, while the asset register and COM-01 state CX500-881. Please reissue the warranty if it is wrong. 3) Correct the tag on COM-01 from AHU-14 to AHU-014 at the next issue.
uncertainties: Which serial is correct (CX500-818 or CX500-881) is unknown until the manufacturer confirms.
Whether and when the consultant will sign the commissioning approval is unknown.
